text.p: Brondby (Denmark) beat Tenerife (Spain) 1-0 (halftime 1-0) in a UEFA Cup quarter-final first leg on Tuesday:

Tenerife: 1-Marcelo Ojeda, 6-Antonio Mata, 22-Cesar Gomez (20-Antonio Pinilla 74), 8-Chano Cruzado, 11-Juanele Castanos, 6-Slavisa Jokanovic, 3-Alexis Suarez, 10-Felipe Minambres, 14-Angel Vivar Dorado 9-Meho Kodro (16-Antonio Robaina 70), 26-Sizwe Motaung (19-Dani Gonzalez 46).

Brondby: 1-Mogens Krogh, 2-Ole Bjur, 16-Dan Eggen, 4-Morten Nielsen, 23-Anders Bjerregard (8-Kim Daugaard 82), 17-John Jensen, 14-Soren Colding, 15-Ruben Bagger, 9-Peter Moller (13-Bo Hansen 85), 12-Ebbe Sand (10-Thomas Thogersen 75), 11-Kim Vilfort.
